## Targets (ChEMBL / Open Targets) 
ABL1, DDR1, DDR2, PDGFRB, KIT, BCR 
Variant Targets (CIViC): BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 V299L, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 Y253H, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 G250E, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 E255K, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 F359C, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 F359V, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 E255V, BCR::ABL1 Fusion AND ABL1 F317L 
## Indications (Open Targets) 
 
Blastic phase chronic myeloid leukemia, Chronic Myelocytic Leukemia Accelerated Phase, Chronic eosinophilic leukemia, Chronic phase chronic myeloid leukemia, Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, Gastrointestinal stromal tumor, breast cancer (Phase 1), ocular melanoma (Phase 2), neoplasm (Approved), myelodysplastic syndrome (Phase 1), non-Hodgkin lymphoma (Phase 1/2), graft versus host disease (Phase 3)
